description: Predicted Building Damage: Colombia Earthquake 2026 is a dataset listed in Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue, a cloud catalogue of environmental and geospatial data sets, published or maintained by Microsoft AI for Good Lab. Creamos evaluaciones de daños a nivel de edificio tras el terremoto en Colombia mediante el entrenamiento y la posterior ejecución de un modelo de inteligencia artificial sobre imágenes satelitales adquiridas después del desastre. El modelo de IA clasifica cada edificio identificado en las imágenes como "sin daños", "afectado" o "desconocido". Coverage: buildings around Cali and Pereira after the August 2026 earthquake. The catalogue entry lists assets named google-buildings, overture-buildings, valid-area-mask, visual, reachable through the STAC API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure exposure, hazard and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-planetary-computer-catalogue.
